Messages.Author: Derek Ray
Messages.Body:
On Wed, 07 Feb 2001 18:54:27 GMT, rade...@my-deja.com wrote:

>In article Pat Ricochet <sp...@socrates.gatech.edu> wrote:
>> I'm pretty sure this was the deck that had one copy of Christine
>> Boscacci in local play, but that for tournament play, the
>Christine/Blessing
>> of Chaos "prayer combo" was taken out.
>
>I've read the text on the vampire and this card, and still have to ask:
>What is the prayer combo??

Christine gets a skill card and the Blessing of Chaos, and remains
untapped for the rest of the game. Her only words are "I ATTEMPT TO
BLOCK!", preferably nothing but 1-stealth or greater actions taken by
predator or prey. She doesn't have to SUCCESSFULLY block, she just
has to attempt to block. Since she gets -1 intercept against any
minion attempting to bleed, you have a pretty handy defense against
Dominate bleed and Presence vote... all without ever tapping a minion.
Not so much Presence bleed since those tend to come in the form of
action -cards-.

Prayer combo because it requires three things to show up early on: a
specific vampire, a skill card, and the Blessing itself. =)

-- Derek
